text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...That sums it up quite nicely. What do
you think,
Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm... I must say it sounds... quite nice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: U-um, Rice... What did you... just say?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I am simply trying to... emulate
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
D-do I really speak in such a manner?
Surely you
must be exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No. You always speak so politely... like a
princess
in a picture book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Well. When you say that with such
sparkling
eyes, how can I tell you to
stop...
